description: This Java class `UpdateCollateralCommandHandler` handles update commands related to collateral within the Fineract project. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface and delegates the update operation to a `CollateralWritePlatformService`. The class is annotated for Spring to recognize it as a service and a specific command handler for the 'COLLATERAL' entity with 'UPDATE' action.

classes.name: UpdateCollateralCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles update commands for collateral entities; processes commands and delegates the update operation to the collateral write service.

methods.name: UpdateCollateralCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the CollateralWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes an incoming JsonCommand to perform collateral update, returning the result from the write platform service.
